mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2% for 3 months and S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals the end of emergency rate cuts and the beginning of a tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS crosses above 0.5%, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of such events.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of CPIAUCSL above 215 and INDPRO above 95 signals accelerating economic activity and inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed may tighten policy.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 215 AND INDPRO > 95, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of such events.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 9.5%), the S&P 500 tends to have positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to expectations of continued accommodative monetary policy and economic recovery.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE > 9.5%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: The level of industrial production (INDPRO) is always associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as the series is a leading indicator of economic activity supporting corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 90, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 signals a deepening recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic conditions deteriorate.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 90, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of such events.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of RSAFS above 350000 and HOUST above 580 signals a strengthening consumer sector that supports economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 350000 AND HOUST > 580, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of such events.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-housing-demand regime (HOUST > 600), the S&P 500 tends to have positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as housing is a leading indicator of economic activity supporting consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: In periods when HOUST > 600, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
